chapter: The band, its players and singers
title: Later tenor players and pairing two good tenors; trumpets and clarinets
summary: Basie says he would pair any two good tenors, such as Buddy Tate, Don Byas or Ben Webster, and that clarinets were doubles. The tape ends.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Okay, so Buddy came next and Buddy came into Hershel's spot. Is that right, the big sound?
Yeah.
And who came into Lester's spot?
Let's see, you know one thing, I really got to go back there and think. That's a long time ago. All right.
Byas. When did Don Byas come in?
Oh, I think maybe. Yeah.
And did you always hear them as the combination of Lester and Hershel or did they --
It was --

I mean did you always know that there was the original sound of those two and the fact that you wanted to keep going. I mean, Hershel and Lester were there originally and they were the sound you heard and they

were the tenor men that you brought up and made the soloists, this was a whole new thing, so I was just wondering if the tenor men that came afterwards although they were individualists of course, still they were there. Still the original concept was Lester and Hershel sound. The big and the laid back. If you want to call it that.
I couldn't very well hold on to sound as well because Lester's sound was a different thing, you know, but I mean I would say the same formula I leaned pretty heavy on it, like the tenor.
I mean so you wouldn't have -- in other words, you wouldn't have Buddy Tate and say, Ben Webster together?
Why not?
Oh, you would. Okay. I mean, would you have Chu and --
I would have any two tenor saxophone players, any two good tenors, if I could get them, you know.
Let me ask you this: would you possibly -- you couldn't possibly have Paul Quinichette and Wardell Gray Delagray together?
Oh, yeah. I don't know, I don't see why I couldn't, would you?
I really don't know.
They would get along.
How about trumpet? You had Buck and Sweets together, of course?
Yeah.
Let me ask you this: did you ever have a clarinet?
Sure. Sure, I did. They were doubles.
Oh. Did Lester play clarinet in the band?
Every now and then, he did --
Yeah.
(End of proceedings as recorded.)
